newsitem.title: USA: John Alden sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: John Alden sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: John Alden Financial Corp said on Friday its board of directors declared a dividend distribution of one preferred share purchase right on each outstanding common stock.

Rights were designed to ensure shareholders received fair treatment in case of a proposed takeover of the company, and to guard against partial tender offers, squeeze outs, open market accumulations and other such tactics, the company said.
The plan was not undertaken in response to any takeover proposals, it said.

The rights would be exercisable only if a person or group acquired 10 percent or more of John Alden's common stock or announced a tender offer which would result in ownership by a person or group of 10 percent or more of the common stock.
